packageRules.description: Majors open as drafts with no automerge, so they wait for the Kernel Coordinator, who marks them ready.
Updates to files under .github/ (the pipeline pin) change CI itself: drafts with no automerge, so they wait for the Kernel Coordinator.
wasix-python and its py-* extension packages are built against one CPython: they bump together, in one PR, so a new numpy never meets the old python (#1180, #1181).
The slicc-shared-web npm package and the pipeline.yml ref in ci.yml move together, in one PR, so the harness and the pipeline stay at one release (workflows.test.mjs holds them equal).
